C0439.title: BigCommerce Merchant Hit by Unstoppable Persistent Carding Attack
C0439.summary: In November 2025, a BigCommerce merchant posted in the support community and on Reddit that their store had been hit by a carding attack for about a month, with malicious requests targeting the BigCommerce-controlled payments.bigcommerce.com payment domain. The merchant said they could not control that domain, while BigCommerce said mitigation was the merchant's responsibility. The attack generated about $7,000 in costs, forced the merchant to disable credit cards and use PayPal, and led them to consider changing payment processors or migrating platforms.
